record.context: See scope and source notes; national restrictions are recorded once, not once per neighbouring country.
record.uncertainty: Official and police-attributed sources establish June 2020 removal of the COVID valid-entry-purpose requirement. The Federal Police retrospective says controls ended 15 June, whereas contemporary Kempten reporting says at the end of 15 June. Exact 15/16 June permission/implementation timing is not resolved. Earlier Luxembourg and route reopenings mean no continuous all-frontier interval. Separate migration controls at Austria continued.
